decisions.statement: A file is a page or a property of a page as the page file name says.
A page and the properties beside that page are counted under one page type.
A property is counted under the page type its name has.
A secret beside a page is no property.
A file that is neither a page nor a property is counted under the total alone.
A generated file is not counted.
Page types are ordered by the lines a page type has in its pages and its properties together.
A file that could not be read is counted with no lines.
A file that could not be read is named under the total.
What page types there are is read from the index rather than from the names met.

definition: how many pages and property files each page type holds, and how many lines each runs to
